title: In the works
direction: A×C · Round 8 · /insights · LG static status ledger, two shelves (ruled seam)
summary: Everything unpublished in one honest list, with no dates, as two shelves side by side: the next three field notes and the three longer documents moved here from /reports. Each item has the kit's dashed status chip; each shelf ends on one request that names its items.
story: Third beat, and deliberately the quietest. After the published notes and a page of one, the page says plainly what is still being written, and that GTM Intelligence gets two of the next three notes. A visitor who is not ready to talk can ask for a shelf by name. Research no longer sits on /reports, so that page is only about the readout.

reference.borrowed: An index page's quiet ledger: a group name over its entries, mono index, title, one line of state.
reference.kelwin: Two shelves on the 12-column grid, “Field notes” (FN·04–06, cols 1–6) and “Longer documents” (R·01–03, cols 7–12), each under a line-2 hairline with its index range on the right. Each row reads: mono index · title, then the note's layer in mono and the kit's dashed status chip using the five allowed words. Each shelf ends on the kit's quiet .ac-link into /contact with the shelf as its ?ref. Type and hairlines only. No dates, no progress bars, nothing implied to be further along than it is. Rows line up across the two shelves.
